terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to Feedants. By creating an account or entering a competition you agree to these Terms. Feedants is a portfolio demo: payments run in test mode and no real money is collected or paid out.

sections.heading: Eligibility
body: You need an email address you can receive sign-in codes at. You are responsible for keeping access to that inbox secure and for all activity under your account.

sections.heading: Competitions & submissions
body: Hosts set the title, prize pool, entry fee, schedule and number of spots for each competition, and fund the prize pool before it goes live.

By submitting an entry you confirm that the work is original and that you have the rights to it. Entries are locked once submitted. The host scores every entry from 0 to 10, and published results are final.

sections.heading: Fees, prizes & refunds
body: Entry fees, if any, are shown before you join and are processed through Razorpay in test mode.

If a competition is cancelled, every paid entry is refunded in full and the prize pool returns to the host. Prizes are credited to your in-app Wallet when results are published; withdrawals to a bank arrive in a later release.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
body: Do not harass other users, upload unlawful or harmful content, or try to manipulate judging.
We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these Terms.

sections.heading: Disclaimers & liability
body: Feedants is provided “as is” as a demonstration. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from its use.

sections.heading: Changes to these Terms
body: We may update these Terms. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised Terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what Feedants stores and why. We keep only what we need to run competitions: your email address, display name, profile photo and bio, plus the entries and payments you make.

sections.heading: Information we collect
body: Account details you provide — your email address, display name, bio and profile photo.
Content you create — competitions you host, and your entries with their media and captions.
Records of entry fees, prize pools, prizes and refunds. Card and UPI details are handled by Razorpay and never stored by us.

sections.heading: How we use your data
body: To run competitions: registrations, submissions, judging, results and the wallet.
To send in-app notifications about your entries, results and payments, and to keep Feedants safe from abuse.

sections.heading: When we share information
body: Hosts see the entries submitted to their competitions, with the entrant's name and photo. Winners' names and photos appear on public results.
Our payment processor (Razorpay) receives what it needs to take a payment. We never sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Your rights & choices
body: You can edit your name, bio and photo at any time from Edit Profile.
You can delete your account from Settings. Your name, email, photo and bio are removed; payment records needed for accounting are kept without your profile attached.

sections.heading: Data security & retention
body: Sign-in uses one-time codes sent to your email, so there is no password to leak. Data is encrypted in transit and access is restricted.
We keep your information while your account is active, or as long as needed to provide the service.
